compartment.title: Implemented Phase A image pipeline fixes

compartments.compartment: Added image URLs to the lesson generation prompt, created a post‑processor that injects images when none are inlined, and de‑duplicated the Visual References gallery. Updated `apps/web/src/app/api/onboarding/generate/route.ts`, added `packages/ai/src/lib/inject-images.ts`, and modified the lesson page rendering. All tests, lint, and E2E suites pass. U: I need help in planning an enhancement to the lessons. I want the lessons to be easier to read, and more fun. There must be some way to be able to find and attach images to the lessons, but I don't know how to get pictures that are relevant and/or accurate? U: Yes go with your plan

Queried the database and confirmed that existing lessons contain no inline images and no source image URLs, explaining that the prior pipeline never exposed search images to the AI and that the search providers may not be returning images.

Built a Key Takeaways card that extracts the final summary section from lesson markdown and renders it in a highlighted amber card. Added thin horizontal rules to callout blocks for visual separation. All changes pass the full test suite. U: I don't think I've created a tavily account, and searxng isn't installed yet. So that's probably why.. Let's continue with phase B instead, and I'll verify images another day

Added a sticky Section Navigator for lessons with three or more sections, introduced an image quality gate component that shows placeholders and graceful fallbacks, displayed captions and source domains below each inline image, and generated a Key Terms card that lists bolded terms extracted from the lesson content. All tests pass and the changes are pushed. U: yes do all of them

Ran a Playwright script to capture three representative pages (landing hero, explore page, onboarding chat), stored them under `screenshots/` (converted to JPEG where appropriate), and updated the README to showcase these images with captions. U: Could you take a few screenshots of the site for the readme. Do 3 that represents the application best and add them to the readme

compartment.title: Added dynamic lesson categories and search

compartments.compartment: Extended the `curricula` table with nullable `category` and `subcategory` text columns; AI now emits these fields during curriculum generation, and users can edit them on the curriculum detail page. Implemented server‑side discovery of distinct categories, a public tRPC procedure to list categories, and optional `categorySlug`, `subcategorySlug`, and `search` parameters on the explore endpoint. Updated web and mobile explore pages with filter chips and a unified search bar that queries title, description, and the user's original learning‑profile topic. U: The lessons should have a category, and a subcategory, to make it easier for users to find lessons they are interested in. You should be able to filter on category (optional) Ideally I'd like to add some sort of search functionality, but I don't know what to search for. Do you have any ideas of what to include in a search? U: Is it a good idea to add categories for lessons that don't exist yet? Maybe add categories as they're created. I think the ai can classify, but maybe let the user override this plan looks good

facts.ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS:
* Curricula store optional `category` and `subcategory` text fields; AI assigns them during generation and users may override on the curriculum page. * Lesson page now includes a Section Navigator, an image quality‑gate component with placeholder and error fallback, inline image captions with source attribution, and a Key Terms card that lists extracted bolded terms.
* When adding new tRPC procedures, also add them to the `resolveData` resolver in `apps/web/tests/e2e/fixtures.ts` to avoid silent test failures.
